name: Pubperf Analytics
author: Transfon

sections.description:
Pubperf Analytics provides all-in-one performance analytics for publishers: website speed monitoring, Prebid.js and header bidding analytics, ad revenue analytics, real user experience monitoring, and website uptime checking.

Realtime Prebid.js and Header Bidding Analytics

Lighthouse Performance Snapshots

Real User Performance Monitoring

Ad Revenue and Content Performance Analytics

Features:

  • Realtime Prebid.js and Header Bidding Analytics
  • Lighthouse Performance Snapshots
  • Real User Performance Monitoring
  • Ads Loading Speed and Total Request Count
  • Website Speed Index and Memory Usage
  • Header Bidding Percentage and Bidders Monitoring
  • Ad Revenue Analytics
  • Content Performance Analytics
  • Website Uptime Monitoring
sections.installation:
1. Upload pubperf to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Pubperf Analytics, enter your Pubperf Website ID (license key), and click Save
sections.faq:
How do I get my license key?

Visit pubperf.com and sign up for an account. Your license key (license-xxxxxx) can be found in the install section of your dashboard.

When will I start seeing data?

Once you have added your license key and the tracking script is active on your site, data collection begins immediately and is displayed in your dashboard.

What analytics does Pubperf provide?

Pubperf provides comprehensive analytics including realtime Prebid.js and Header bidding analytics, webpage speed analytics, ad revenue analytics, content performance analytics, and enhanced Lighthouse report snapshots.

Can I use it for free?

Yes, Pubperf is free to use for websites with up to 50K users per month.

Do you offer a premium plan?

Yes. Please check the pricing at Pubperf Official site.
